maddeler.e:
ننزلق (form VII)
# نَنْزَلِقُ (nanzaliqu) /nan.za.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
# نَنْزَلِقَ (nanzaliqa) /nan.za.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
# نَنْزَلِقْ (nanzaliq) /nan.za.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
